title: Nvidia Startup Stakes Reach $65 Billion Amid Deal Uncertainties
excerpt: Nvidia's private investments tripled in value over nine months, though Jensen Huang's exit creates questions for future deals.
body_html:
Nvidia has seen the value of its private investments grow significantly over a recent nine-month period, reaching $65 billion. This growth was driven by increasing valuations within its current portfolio and active dealmaking led by Jensen Huang.

Despite this substantial financial expansion, the future direction of the company's investment strategy remains uncertain. The planned exit of Jensen Huang has raised questions regarding whether Nvidia will continue to pursue these high-profile startup deals at the same pace moving forward.
